meta.title: AD&D 2nd Edition Forgotten Realms gods (Time of Troubles / Godswar)
meta.source: Owner-supplied spreadsheet forgotten_realms_gods_time_of_troubles.xlsx (sheets: Human Pantheon, Dwarves, Elves, Gnomes, Halflings, Orcs & Half-Orcs)

fields.printed: Text exactly as in the spreadsheet. name is the same text with an obvious typo or spelling variant corrected (Sythe to Scythe, Blind-fight to Blind-fighting).
fields.worshipperAlignments: List of allowed worshipper alignments; null where the sheet gives text instead of codes (see worshipperAlignmentsPrinted).
fields.allowedWeapons[].match: exact = the gear.json weapon(s) named in gearIds (more than one where the owner confirmed several versions are allowed, e.g. Mace = Footman's and Horseman's); spellingVariant = printed name differs from the gear name, owner confirmed (Staff = Quarterstaff); category / natural / none = not a single weapon; notInGear = no such weapon in gear.json. gearId is the single id where there is exactly one, otherwise null. armourIds is used where the item is a shield in gear.json armour.
fields.requiredProficiency / bonusProficiency: nonWeaponId links to rules-skills.json proficiencies.nonWeapon.list. match: exact (matchNote records a confirmed spelling difference) or notInJson (no such nonweapon proficiency in the current JSON files). A bracketed part such as (Forest) is kept as specialisation.
fields.godswarStatus: Human Pantheon sheet only, as printed.
fields.bonusProficiency: Usually a single object. A god may have a list of objects where several bonus proficiencies are given (Clangeddin Silverbeard, owner-supplied). appliesTo: who receives it (clerics).
fields.requiredProficiency: A single object, or null where the god has no required proficiency (Clangeddin Silverbeard, owner-supplied).

notes: No values were added beyond the spreadsheet. The dwarf, elf, gnome, halfling and orc sheets have no Godswar status column.
Worshipper alignments printed as text (for example Any (Trade focuses on gold, not alignment)) are kept as text.
All proficiencies now exist in rules-skills.json; the 20 not on PHB Table 37 were added from the owner list.

Torm (owner-changed): Warhammer and Mace removed from allowedWeapons (weapons now follow the generic cleric rule); required proficiency Etiquette (uses a slot); bonus proficiencies Religion, Heraldry and Riding, Land-based (no slots); Righteous Fury removed.
Silvanus (owner-changed): Sickle and Club removed from allowedWeapons (covered by the Druid class); Nature's Wrath removed.

Silvanus (owner-changed): required proficiencies Animal Lore plus two of Brewing, Cobbling, Cooking, Fishing, Weaving (slots); bonus Religion, Survival (Forest), Weather Sense (no slots). Herbalism removed.
